candidates.denominator: nodes with deg>=2; degree<2 nodes counted in coverage only

candidates.denominator: all quotient nodes; absent triangles count as 0, not undefined
candidates.formula: mean t_v over all quotient nodes

candidates.formula: mean over parents of mean child degree
candidates.name: sibling_degree_mean_mean

candidates.formula: mean over parents of p90 child degree
candidates.name: sibling_degree_p90_mean

candidates.formula: mean over parents of parent Forman mean
candidates.name: sibling_forman_mean

candidates.formula: mean over parents of parent Forman negative fraction
candidates.name: sibling_forman_negative_fraction

candidates.formula: density of Q_l restricted to multi-item prefixes
